source_of_truth: Playgama publishes no pixel sizes, formats, byte caps or character limits for listing media anywhere in its documentation. The console's own upload form is the only authority; the numbers below were read off the form when the first draft was created and are re-read on every new draft.
confirmed_by_docs: the archive keeps index.html at its root and Latin-only file names
the archive stays under 300 MB, and partner channels cap it far lower (MSN 50 MB, YouTube 30 MB, TikTok 30 MB, GameSnacks 15 MiB initial)
playgama-bridge-config.json sits next to index.html and is fetched by the Bridge itself
media in the draft is an optional field: good media improves catalogue presentation
sound and gameplay are both paused for the whole of an interstitial or rewarded ad
a rewarded call-to-action carries an AD label or icon

assets.note: Cover Images / Square 1:1. The form names the size; no byte cap shown. A frame from the game is allowed.

undocumented: listing text character limits are not shown by the form either; the caps here are the studio's own working limits
confirmed_by_form: the draft form is single-language: one title, one description, one how-to-play, all in English; game languages are declared as a tag list (English, Russian, ...)
Cover Images take exactly three slots, Square 1:1 800x800, Portrait 9:16 1080x1920, Landscape 16:9 1920x1080, formats .mpeg/.jpeg/.png, no byte cap shown
Other Assets (screenshots, videos, covers) are optional, .mpeg/.jpeg/.png or .zip, max 300 MB; the widget accepts one file per selection even when several are chosen
the archive widget takes one .zip, max 300 MB, index.html at the root
Supported Devices (Desktop, iOS, Android), Screen Orientation (Portrait, Landscape) and Game Features are checkboxes; Distribution consent is on by default
Save parks the draft; submission for moderation is a separate action on the game's dashboard
